# `igdev gateway restart`

restart restarts the Gateway container in place, keeping its named volume and its
recorded ports.

## Usage

```text
igdev gateway restart [flags]
```

## Examples

```text
  igdev gateway restart
  igdev gateway restart --json
```

## Options

```text
  -h, --help   help for restart
```

## Global options

```text
      --config stringArray   override one config key for this run, key=value (highest precedence)
      --json                 emit the JSON envelope on stdout (machine mode)
```

## Agent usage

pass --json for the machine contract. data is the address block:
instance_id, namespace, url, and ports. The named volume is kept, so nothing is restored
and no state is lost; use igdev gateway reset when a fresh Gateway is what is wanted.
